rendered: The document does not pick 120 μM[1] as optimal. The CD signal of BA@L-HGNRs was enhanced over the sweep from 0 to 120 μM[2], so that value is only the top of the tested range, not the optimum. Further increases up to 225 μM[3] gave only marginal changes, and the CD intensity peaked at 165 μM[4]. The authors chose 165 μM[5] as the optimized ligand concentration for all later experiments. Their reasons were the CD maximum at that concentration, followed by a slight decrease at higher concentrations, and the exceptional spectral stability of particles made at that concentration during the whole monitoring period in NH4HCO3 buffer.[6][7]
